description: WHO CAN DO THIS FOR ME? Say what you need ("weather forecast", "translate to Spanish", "image generation") and, if you like, the most you will pay per call. Returns up to 10 paid x402 services you can pay right now, best payment record first: what each does, the endpoint to call, its price, the wallet to pay (USDC on Base) and the check_payment verdict for it. The ones after the first are backups, each a different seller. Only services that answered a check in the last 3 days asking to be paid at their own wallet are shown, and none the payment check stops. Rank is never for sale. Free, no key.

limit.description: Optional: how many sellers, 1 to 10 (5 if left out).

max_price_usd.description: Optional: the most you will pay per call, in US dollars.

need.description: What the service should do, in a few words.
